title: End of free backend for AL Object ID Ninja
summary: AL Object ID Ninja, a free tool for managing object IDs in Business Central development, transitions from a free community service to a premium subscription model on January 1, 2026, while offering self-hosting as a free alternative.
key_points: The free backend for AL Object ID Ninja will end on December 31, 2025, after four years of free service
Developers can choose between subscribing to Premium Ninja (with new features, support, and management portal) or self-hosting on their own Azure subscription
Premium pricing will be based on fair usage, likely per app, with a free tier for minimal consumption
Self-hosted users will maintain full control but must handle updates, redeployment, and maintenance themselves
The tool has prevented hundreds of thousands of conflicts across thousands of development teams

quotes.text: Ninja has quietly prevented hundreds of thousands of conflicts across thousands of teams.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the tool's real-world value and widespread adoption in the BC development community

quotes.text: You can continue using Ninja for free until 31 December 2025.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides clear deadline for developers to decide between subscription and self-hosting options

quotes.text: It's the same simple tool you love - now backed by a sustainable model that guarantees it will stay that way.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the rationale for the change while reassuring users the tool's functionality and philosophy remain unchanged
